info.name: Cadillac Man - Mister occasionissima
info.plot: Venditore di auto usate in crisi coniugale e indebitato con la mafia trova la soluzione a tutto quando un tale, geloso della fidanzata, irrompe nel suo salone e lo prende in ostaggio con tutti i clienti presenti.

translations.overview: Joe's a car salesman with a problem—he has two days to sell 12 cars or he loses his job. This would be a difficult task at the best of times but Joe has to contend with his girlfriends (he's two-timing), a missing teenage daughter and an ex-wife.
translations.tagline: If you can't trust a car salesman who can you trust?
